lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance white circular blobs arranged in roughly linear horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Pale vertical bands intersect with horizontal ridges and rows of blobs to form a distinct grid-like pattern on the posterior flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with light intensity on the dorsal edge and shadowing on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive occlusion of the branchial region and the base of the pectoral fin by a high-density school of small, silver-blue teleost fish.
